title: The Complex machine in the shed
subtitle: 科技与创新 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）
meta: 主题语境：科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）　|　核心词汇：complex　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 complex 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the cook wrote of ① a complex machine in the shed in the menu, and everybody in the canteen said at once that it was ② more complex than the one named there the year before. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the cook, who never explained anything, had done it with great care and gone home; it was the complex ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most complex machine in the shed anybody in the canteen had ever seen, or so the menu for September 1960 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too complex to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the guest who had come to help; the complex ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bowl at the far table, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a complex problem with the water, and said that no guest in his right mind would call it ⑥ as complex as the problem with the water they had once had in the old canteen. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was complex or not, and he said so.

By 1973 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the menu. What the line asked for was ⑦ something complex, and nothing besides. The guest from the next canteen called the whole plan ⑧ quite complex; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the menu kept the names of the complex ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1976, on the same day, she wrote of another complex machine in the shed in the same menu, and the work, which took two days, seemed ⑨ more complex than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most complex problem with the water in the whole canteen, she said in 1978, was the one she could never quite name; the complex ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 复杂（前置定语 a complex machine in the shed：1966 年厨子在菜单里记下的那件复杂的机器）
B. adj. 复杂／难解（比较级 more complex than：文中两处，一处比棚里的机器，一处比预想）
C. adj. 复杂／难解（最高级 the most complex：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 复杂（表语 too complex to do：母亲觉得它太复杂，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 难解（前置定语 a complex problem with the water：叔叔把整件事称作一桩难解的问题）
F. adj. 难解（同级比较 as complex as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩用水的问题相比）
G. adj. 难解（后置定语 something complex：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 难解（受程度副词修饰 quite complex：那位客人的评价）

items.q: a complex machine in the shed
the most complex machine in the shed anybody
a complex problem with the water
The most complex problem with the water in

answers.why: complex 意为“复杂”，1966 年厨子在菜单里记下的是“一件复杂的机器”，此处作前置定语 a complex machine in the shed。
complex 意为“复杂”，此处用比较级 more complex than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
complex 意为“复杂”，菜单上 九月 那行字说它是食堂里最复杂的一件，故用最高级 the most complex machine in the shed。
complex 意为“复杂”，母亲认为这件东西“太复杂了，谁也用不上”，too complex to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
complex 意为“难解”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩难解的问题”，此处作前置定语 a complex problem with the water。
complex 意为“难解”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩用水的问题一样难解”，同级比较用 as complex as。
complex 意为“难解”，菜单上那半行字要的是“难解的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something complex。
complex 意为“难解”，邻食堂来的那位客人认为这套计划“相当难解”，quite 修饰原级 complex。
complex 意为“难解”，1976 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要难解”，故用比较级 more complex than。
complex 意为“难解”，母亲 1978 年说的是“整个食堂里最难解的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most complex problem with the water。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1966 年，厨子在菜单里记下了一件复杂的机器。（a complex machine in the shed）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更复杂。（more complex than …）
母亲觉得它太复杂，谁也用不上。（too complex to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩难解的问题。（a complex problem with the water）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩用水的问题一样难解。（as complex as …）
到了 1973 年，菜单上只剩半行字：要的是一件难解的东西。（something complex）
answers: In 1966 the cook wrote of a complex machine in the shed in the menu.
Everybody said it was more complex than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too complex to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a complex problem with the water.
He said nobody would call it as complex as the problem with the water they had once had.
By 1973 the menu asked for nothing but something complex.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 complex 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1966 the cook wrote of a complex machine in the shed in the menu, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most complex machine in the shed in the canteen, or so the menu says.
My mother thought it too complex to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a complex problem with the water, and nobody argued with him.
The guest from the next canteen called the plan quite complex, and everybody laughed.
The complex ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
